items.title: Karate’s near-misses dent Nepal’s medal hopes at Asian Games
items.desc: Erika Gurung and two other karatekas reached the semifinals but failed to secure a medal on a frustrating day in Nagoya.

items.title: Nepal lost Rs10 billion in India’s import squeeze. New Delhi seeks investigation before easing curbs
items.desc: India has also asked Nepal to facilitate market access for its agricultural and dairy products, which face restrictions in Nepal.

items.title: CK Raut re-elected unopposed as Janamat Party chair
items.desc: Raut is the sole candidate for the top post at the party’s second general convention, which will elect 100 other central committee members through a direct vote.

items.title: Diana’s brother compares media treatment of Harry, Meghan to late princess’ ordeal
items.desc: Harry, Diana’s youngest son, and Meghan, cited the impact of what they called ​a toxic media on their lives before they quit royal duties and moved to the United States ‌in 2020.

items.title: Tribhuvan University to hold graduations in all seven provinces
items.desc: Students will be able to choose a graduation centre closer to home, ending the requirement for graduates from across Nepal to travel to Kathmandu.

items.title: World leaders return to UN amid wars in Middle East and Ukraine
items.desc: Leaders confront wars in the Middle East and Ukraine, rising AI risks and a deepening crisis of confidence and funding at the 80-year-old world body.

items.title: Police detain political analyst Bharat Dahal in Morang
items.desc: Dahal was taken to Kathmandu on a warrant issued in the Capital, police say.

items.title: Electric microbus catches fire in Bardiya, no casualties reported
items.desc: The vehicle was travelling from Kohalpur to Kailali when it caught fire on Sunday morning.

items.title: Heavy to very heavy rainfall likely across Nepal from Thursday
items.desc: Weather systems developing over the Andaman Sea and Bay of Bengal could bring prolonged downpours across Nepal from September 24-28. The heaviest rainfall is expected in western and central areas.

items.title: Udayapur Hospital gets services moving again
items.desc: After years of unreliable service, the hospital is getting key units back up and running as it tackles staffing and financial problems.

items.title: Nepal’s Sanu Maya Thing knocked out in Asian Games karate
items.desc: Wushu player Vijay Singhjali also exits in the opening round.

items.title: Flames, smoke seen near Riyadh airport; Houthis claim attacks on Saudi capital
items.desc: The reported strike came amid a surge in Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, with Riyadh warning residents of possible aerial threats and Saudi air defences intercepting a missile.

items.title: Ed Sheeran says he made ‘mistakes’ amid Macklemore controversy
items.desc: The singer says the dispute over free speech and Palestine has drawn him into a complex political debate he never wanted to join.

items.title: Fiction: The making of a revolution
items.desc: As a movement grows after a deadly crackdown, anger, ambition and political opportunism push Deshbhumi towards chaos.

items.title: Lumbini Lions to face Sudurpaschim Royals in NPL opener
items.desc: Reigning champions Lumbini kick off their title defence at Kirtipur, leading a 27-day fixture list that features 21 league matches and four playoff games.

items.title: Can ‘Mission 2026’ finally deliver Nepal its first Asian Games gold?
items.desc: After three years of preparation marred by funding woes, Nepal’s trimmed 135-athlete contingent enters the Asian Games chasing double-digit medals and its first-ever gold.

items.title: Constitution review mired in political debate as parties fail to agree on scope of amendment
items.desc: The Balendra Shah government tasked a panel with preparing for amendments but the effort did not gain support of all political forces.
